top_signals.title: War weighs on Iran’s economy as U.S. intensifies sanctions
top_signals.summary: Iranian leaders are acknowledging the economic toll of war with the U.S., but Tehran has vowed to withstand U.S. pressure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Russia is teaching its children to fight the wars of the future
top_signals.summary: While some of the skills were previously taught in limited high school modules, the new version escalates this training for children as young as 13.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
